title: Two more text models, and a DeepSeek repair
summary:
Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Grok 4 Fast joined the model lineup while image requests, authentication, and policy pages got attention.

Claude Sonnet 4.5 was added as `claude-large` with image input and tool calling. Grok 4 Fast’s non-reasoning model was added as `grok`, also with tool support. DeepSeek V3.1 was updated to use an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

Image generation now retries ComfyUI HTTP 500 errors up to three attempts. Seedream 4.0 downloads reference images server-side to avoid failures when an image host blocks the model provider, and Enter’s image service was configured to use an exact-match cache.

Legacy authentication code was removed, and MCP authentication, configuration, registration links, and documentation were updated to point to enter.pollinations.ai.
